blocks.title: Qanooni nataij
blocks.text: Terms of use todne ke sangeen qanooni nataij ho sakte hain: users par jurmana, muqadma ya service se pabandi lag sakti hai.

Baghair licence software istemal karne par piracy ki qanooni karwai ho sakti hai, aur baghair licence software chalane wali companies cyber khatron mein bhi hoti hain. PayPak jaisi digital payment service ke zariye dhoka ya ghair mujaz len den par jurmana ya fojdari muqadma ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Baghair licence software ke do khatre bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Software piracy par qanooni karwai, aur security khatre kyunke chori ki copies mein malware ho sakta aur updates nahi milte.

items: Terms of use todna jurmana, muqadma, pabandi ya fojdari karwai la sakta hai (software piracy, payment fraud).
